about.heading: Mangalnath Temple, Ujjain
about.description: Mangalnath Temple is one of the most sacred temples in Ujjain, believed to be the birthplace of Mangal Grah (Mars). Situated on the banks of the holy Shipra river, this ancient temple attracts thousands of devotees seeking relief from Mangal Dosha and other planetary afflictions.
about.paragraph1: Mangalnath Temple in Ujjain is considered the sacred birthplace of Mangal Grah (Planet Mars). Performing puja here helps reduce planetary doshas and brings peace, success, and stability.
about.paragraph2: Devotees from across India visit this holy place to perform powerful rituals like Kaal Sarp Dosh Puja, Mangal Dosh Shanti, Pitru Dosh Nivaran, and other Vedic anushthans.
about.pandit_experience: 15+ years of experience in Kaal Sarp Dosh Puja, Mangal Dosh Shanti, Narayan Bali, Mahamrityunjay Jaap, Rudrabhishek, and Navgrah Shanti.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know about our pooja services.

items.q: How can I book a pooja?
items.a: You can book a pooja by calling us at +91 62605-52014 or messaging us on WhatsApp at +91 80850-39147. You can also fill the contact form on this website.

items.q: Do I need to be physically present for the pooja?
items.a: No, you don't need to be physically present. Our Pandits perform the pooja on your behalf at the temple. You can join live on video call if you wish.

items.q: What information do I need to provide?
items.a: You will need to provide your full name, father's name, gotra, date of birth, city of residence, and specific intentions for the pooja.

items.q: Will I get photos and videos?
items.a: Yes, we provide photos and videos of the entire pooja. In Premium packages, you also get HD video recording and live video call access.

items.q: Is the prasad delivered to my home?
items.a: Yes, prasad is delivered to your home address in Premium and Standard packages. Basic package includes prasad distribution at the temple.

items.q: What is included in the samagri?
items.a: All authentic samagri required for the specific pooja is included in our packages. We use only genuine materials as per Vedic traditions.

items.q: Can I book for someone else?
items.a: Yes, you can book a pooja on behalf of a family member. Just provide their details (name, gotra, etc.) during booking.

items.q: What is the advance payment required?
items.a: We require 50% advance payment at the time of booking. The remaining amount is to be paid before the pooja begins.

items.q: How do I make payment?
items.a: We accept UPI, bank transfer, and cash. Our WhatsApp number is also our UPI ID for easy payment.

items.q: What is your refund policy?
items.a: If you cancel at least 48 hours before the scheduled pooja, you will receive a full refund. Cancellations within 48 hours attract a 25% cancellation fee.

items.q: What poojas can be done for Mangal Dosha?
items.a: Mangal Dosh Puja, Ark Vivah, and Kumbh Vivah are specifically recommended for Mangal Dosha. Our Pandit will guide you to the most suitable one.

items.q: Can I get a temple certificate?
items.a: Yes, temple certificates are provided in Standard and Premium packages as proof of the pooja performed.

items.q: Do you provide services outside Ujjain?
items.a: Our poojas are performed at the Mangalnath and Mahakal temples in Ujjain. Devotees from anywhere in India or abroad can book online.

items.q: How long does a typical pooja take?
items.a: Duration varies by pooja type — simple poojas take 1–2 hours, while elaborate anushthaans can take 4–6 hours.

items.q: Are the Pandits certified?
items.a: Yes, our Pandits are certified and experienced Vedic scholars. Pt. Abhishek Vyas is an authorized Teerth Purohit of Mangalnath Temple, Ujjain.

items.q: What is Kaal Sarp Dosh Puja?
items.a: Kaal Sarp Dosh occurs when all seven planets are between Rahu and Ketu. This puja at Mangalnath Temple is highly effective for removing this dosha.

items.q: Can I request a specific date for the pooja?
items.a: Yes, we try our best to accommodate your preferred date. Some poojas are best performed on specific auspicious dates (muhurta) — our Pandit will advise.

items.q: What is Narayan Bali?
items.a: Narayan Bali is an important ritual for the peace and moksha of ancestors. It is performed to relieve Pitru Dosha and bring peace to the departed souls.

items.q: Is Mangalnath Temple open all year?
items.a: Yes, Mangalnath Temple is open all days from 5:00 AM to 10:00 PM throughout the year, including holidays.

items.q: How do I know the pooja was performed for me?
items.a: We provide full documentation including photos, videos, and a temple certificate. You can also join the pooja live on a video call.
